title: Perspectives in Play: A Multi-Perspective Approach for More Inclusive NLP Systems

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model alignment with diverse human label distributions (measured via Jensen-Shannon Divergence) and classification performance (F1-score) using a multi-perspective soft label approach versus traditional majority-vote hard labels on subjective tasks (hate speech, abusive language, irony, and stance detection). Explainable AI (XAI) techniques are also used to analyze token-level feature attribution and how models interpret minority perspectives.
